item.text: {"category_edits":[{"category":"learning_objective","rationale":"Add a modest unweighted pairwise ranking term to the existing weighted loss to improve positive-negative separation across all four datasets. Reuse existing scores and masks, preserving the GRU architecture, sampling, optimizer, schedule, routing, and single-model checkpoints.","edits":[{"find":"    return (weights * pairwise_loss).sum()","replace":"    return (weights * pairwise_loss).sum() + 0.1 * pairwise_loss.mean()"}]}],"change_summary":"Add 0.1 × mean(softplus(s_neg − s_pos)) to the existing loss. No predictor changes are required."}
